en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 4. And from the previous chain from Ibrahim b. Ishaq from Ismail al-Sufi from al-Abbas b. Abi al-Abbas from Ubdus b. Ibrahim al-Baghdadi who raised this narration to Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:
“One who applies henna from head to toe after using Noorah (depilatory made of lime) his poverty would end.”
